b1c0ab46e87b.source:
夜晚，
图书馆外墙银辉的本钟，
b1c0ab46e87b.translation:
Night.
The clock on the library wall gleams silver,

d0856f85fea0.source: 裹着一对幸福的小情人，
d0856f85fea0.translation: folding around two happy young lovers,

7d623e1921c7.translation: prisoners who already know the day they will die,

5cff86b5bcb9.source: 在谈选着最后一日前延后一日的但是必会到来的最后一日的游玩，
5cff86b5bcb9.translation: trying to choose an outing for the last day, a day they keep putting off by one more day, though it will come.

9fe12920818e.source: 时不时出现在树枝中镂空的区域中，
9fe12920818e.translation: appearing now and then in the gaps between the branches.

9afc5e31b257.source: 时间依旧依旧不停止的
9afc5e31b257.translation: time goes on and on, never stopping,

42237e50fdb2.source:
通往
诗总是会烂尾的，
现实。
42237e50fdb2.translation:
toward
poems always fall apart at the end,
reality.

96443fb14ca8.source: 这是在快要结束的之前

5fe7bc39fc72.translation: there seems to be nothing for us to do.

95442482af03.translation: At the point where we have to say goodbye,

bae97f1a657d.translation: there seems to be nothing we can do.

poem1.sourceSummary: 这是在快要结束的之前

en.title: Designing This Site’s Front End
en.summary: This site took shape with an experimental set of tools instead of a conventional all-in-one stack.

093509ce7dc9.source: 本站放弃了传统的全家桶方案，选择了更具前瞻性的技术栈：
093509ce7dc9.translation: For this site, I chose an experimental set of tools instead of a conventional all-in-one stack:

31f9ebf2b1a5.source: 开发模式：Vibe Coding —— 抛弃冗余的配置，以灵感和直觉驱动，通过 AI 协同实现极速构建。
translation: Development: vibe coding
— less time spent on configuration, more room to follow an idea and build it quickly with AI.
Core language: TypeScript

78449cd244c0.source: 运行时：Deno —— 强力对标并超越 Node.js！
translation: Runtime: Deno
— a modern alternative to Node.js that aims to go further.

097fe3ee3425.source: 前端框架：Deno Fresh —— 零 JS 运行时开销（Islands Architecture），让页面加载如丝般顺滑，瞬间响应。
translation: Front-end framework: Fresh for Deno
— its islands architecture keeps most of the page free of client-side JavaScript, so pages load quickly and feel responsive.
Content management: Sanity, a headless CMS

687ba92a5f02.source: 部署于Deno Deploy，全部内容均零成本运行，开发者无需花费一分钱。
687ba92a5f02.translation: I hosted it on Deno Deploy and was able to run the whole site without paying for hosting.

3732c2ae15cf.source: 视觉上，我试图在“科技感”与“人文感”之间找到平衡：
3732c2ae15cf.translation: Visually, I wanted the site to feel technological and human at the same time:

883316271532.source: Apple Liquid Glass：引入了 WebGL 驱动的液态玻璃效果，让导航与交互充满流动的生命力，如同 iOS 26。
translation: Apple’s Liquid Glass
— I used WebGL to give the navigation and interactions a fluid, glass-like feel reminiscent of iOS 26.

4bf1af78c317.source: Minimalism（极简主义）：克制的排版，大面积的留白。在 Figma 上经过反复推敲，只为让内容本身成为焦点。
translation: Minimalism
— restrained typography and generous white space, refined through repeated iterations in Figma so the content could take centre stage.

en.title: Typefaces for Long Reading Sessions: What I’ve Learned
en.summary: I finally got the Boox e-reader I’d been looking forward to, and I’ve spent the last two days tinkering with it.

e7f30c465f4b.source: 这是一篇之前在wordpress上写的文章，现在经过了大半年的阅读后，有了一些新的字体想推荐给大家，故针对之前的内容进行了一些修订。祝大家新年快乐！
e7f30c465f4b.translation: I first wrote this piece on WordPress. After another six months or so of reading, I have a few more typefaces to recommend, so I’ve revised the original. Happy New Year!

9c3e86b5130b.source: 终于拿到心心念念的文石了，这两天一直在捣鼓这个家伙。
translation: I finally got the
Boox e-reader
I’d been looking forward to, and I’ve spent the last two days tinkering with it.

8798e52d8832.source: 文石是开放系统，于是就用了很多第三方文字阅读APP（除了微信读书），还有漫画阅读软件效果都不如自带的neo reader效果好。究其原因不过是反应速度和显示效果。但是neo reader的UI也确实丑的脱离现代审美。
8798e52d8832.translation: Boox devices let you install your own apps. I tried several third-party reading apps (setting WeRead aside) and some comics readers, but none worked as well as the built-in NeoReader. It mostly came down to responsiveness and how the text looked on the screen. The interface itself, though, looks like it belongs to another decade.

52dee7c5db56.source: 此外就是neo reader的文字排版感觉很难受，不像微信读书，会很清楚的感觉，本来想琢磨两者之间排版的关系，但是发现了一个好像更重要的东西，就是字体对于阅读的影响，一般情况，大多数人阅读小说或者看信息流的时候，用的都是系统自带的字体，这足以应对一般的阅读情况，但是阅读久了似乎经常会跑神，或者越看越看“虚”。
translation: I also found the typesetting in NeoReader uncomfortable. WeRead felt clearer. I meant to compare their layouts, but something more interesting caught my attention:
how the choice of typeface affects reading

. Most people stick with the system font when reading a novel or scrolling through a feed. It works well enough most of the time. After a while, though, I find myself zoning out, as if the words have lost their edges.

e9b871a6667a.source: 所以我去学习了一下，结合之前看到的一些文章，聊一聊这方面的理解。
e9b871a6667a.translation: I did some digging and went back to a few articles I’d read. Here’s how I’ve come to think about it.

697a3eabb92a.source: 首先，现在数字化字体的“大三元”是宋体，黑体，楷体。
translation: First, the three familiar families of digital Chinese type are
Song (serif), Hei (sans serif), and Kai (regular script)

8e544befa4b3.source: 而大多数手机，电脑厂商自带的字体，大多数都是黑体，我记得我对黑体印象最深的是初中还是小学时期，一篇课文，好像是关于用黑体写求救信的，具体是哪篇忘记了。导致我对黑体的第一印象就是严肃的，重要的。没想到现在用的最多的就是黑体。
translation: Most phones and computers ship with a
Hei-style font
. My strongest early association with Hei comes from a school text about a plea for help written in that style, though I can’t remember which text it was. To me, the type looked
serious and urgent
. I wouldn’t have guessed it would become the type I saw most often.

0bb81d03aa3a.source: 至于为什么各种厂商选择用黑体做默认字体呢？其原因最重要就是液晶显示技术了，显示器显示文字，特别是一个很小的字，是极其困难的。
0bb81d03aa3a.translation: Why did so many manufacturers choose Hei as the default? Much of it comes down to LCDs. Drawing a character clearly on a display, especially at a very small size, is harder than it sounds.

c2c51b1d097d.source: 因为早期分辨率和尺寸的原因，导致显示器的PPI(Pixels Per Inch，每英寸像素量)通常都很低，就算是FHD即 1920*1080 的23寸显示器其ppi不过也才96。而PPI值越低。就会导致锯齿越明显，画面越模糊，颗粒感极强。
translation: Early displays tended to have low pixel density, measured in
pixels per inch
. Even a 23-inch Full HD monitor with a resolution of
is only around 96 pixels per inch. At lower densities, edges look more jagged and text can seem blurry or grainy.

f5c6dd9cad69.source: 而且我们发现大家在用Windows时看字的显示感觉就是一般，能看。而使用Mac时字体显示则清晰锐利很多。
f5c6dd9cad69.translation: Text on a Windows machine can look merely adequate, while on a Mac it often looks distinctly sharper.

2dc593f0a962.source: 其很大原因就来自于此，Windows由于普及率极高，所以大多数与其搭配的都是普通的显示器，包括学校，政府单位，公司基本如此。而假如你能在4K，23寸的显示器上看Windows的字体，或者你使用最近的一些新笔记本，他们字体的显示效果其实是不差的。
translation: Pixel density accounts for a lot of that difference. Windows is so widespread that it often runs on
ordinary monitors
, the kind you find in schools, offices and public institutions. Try a 23-inch 4K display or a recent laptop, though, and text on Windows can look
quite good

51d6d5de9597.source: 早期因为硬件原因做不出更细致的分辨率造成的显示效果差劲，就只能通过软件层弥补，例如微软在Windows上做了ClearType这一项技术来增强文字对比度，使其看起来更加清晰，此外最重要的决定就是将宋体换成黑体即“微软雅黑”。
translation: When the hardware couldn’t offer finer resolution, software had to make up the difference. Microsoft introduced ClearType in Windows to make text appear clearer.
Another consequential decision was to replace the default Song-style interface font with the sans serif Microsoft YaHei.

aa2191f5865c.source: 为什么这么做呢？原因在于，黑体的所有线条的粗细是一样的，也就是所谓的“无衬线”。这样的好处是字体每个笔画所占的像素点更大了，如果宋体它刚刚好有一个弯钩就特别特别细，那在这么差ppi的屏幕上就可能完全看不清。
translation: Why? The strokes in a Hei face are relatively even, and it is
sans serif
. That makes the strokes easier to represent with the pixels available. A fine
hook
in a Song face, on the other hand, can all but disappear on a coarse screen.

85fff6d8ec0b.source: 而在黑体上就不会有这问题。至少一眼看的清楚。而如今包括手机厂商依旧在延续这个套路，例如小米的“兰亭黑”，苹果的PingFang SC，都是在其基础上优化显示效果的。
85fff6d8ec0b.translation: Hei type avoids much of that problem. At a glance, at least, the characters are clear. Phone manufacturers still work on the same principle, refining screen type with faces like Xiaomi’s Lanting Hei and Apple’s PingFang SC.

8e974140c9fd.source: 但是黑体因为风格单一，没有起伏，看起来太轻松，所以就很容易犯困，走神，就像英语阅读时，一开始还能理解这段在说什么，但读着读者，好像单词也都念出来了，但是脑子完全没在进行理解一样，回过神发现自己甚至跳了一段。同理。无衬线的西文字体也没啥起伏，例如标准的Noto Sans，而采用Serif的西文看起来虽然吃力了一点，但是就是读的进去。
translation: The trade-off, for me, is that Hei can feel
so even and effortless that the eye slips over it

. It’s like reading English and following every word at first, only to realise later that I’ve been sounding out the sentences without taking them in. I can even skip a paragraph without noticing. An English sans serif such as Noto Sans can have the same effect. A serif face asks a little more of me, and that extra effort sometimes helps me stay with the text.

e8b6a8efca5f.source: 我估计如果你能坚持读到这里，也已经是头晕晕的了，是吧？
e8b6a8efca5f.translation: If you’ve made it this far, your head might be swimming a little already. Am I right?

b994a9bc73a8.source: 这是因为，手机上显示黑体的都是几个字就完事了，例如“设置”，“微信”。而且就算聊天一般也不可能写个几千字，除非你在给别人发“小作文”。所以基本阅读时间不会超过1-2分钟吧。达不到长时间阅读的门槛，方便不吃力的黑体就非常好用。
translation: On a phone, we mostly encounter Hei in a few words at a time: “Settings”, “WeChat”, and so on. Even in a chat, you rarely get thousands of words unless someone is sending you a whole essay. That’s usually
a minute or two
of reading, nowhere near a long session. For a quick glance,
Hei
is wonderfully easy to read.

7d36c34c3efd.source: 但是在读书，看报的时候，我们通常最少也要阅读超过5分钟的阅读量，这样的话，黑体越到后面越不占优。这也就是为什么所有书籍印刷都不采用黑体的原因。
7d36c34c3efd.translation: Reading a book or a newspaper is different: you’re likely to spend five minutes or more with the text. In my experience, Hei’s advantages fade the longer I read. That helps explain why Song faces are so common in printed Chinese books.

b35c6f1f7692.source: 所以如果你想长时间阅读，目前的手机其实大多数的ppi都是很高的了，apple乔布斯在iPhone4上定义了Retina Display，也就是说当你的屏幕ppi大于300，视网膜就无法分辨出像素点了。(所以目前Kindle，或者文石这类阅读器最高也在300ppi）
translation: Most phones now have a much higher pixel density. When Steve Jobs introduced the Retina display on the iPhone 4, the idea was that at roughly 300 pixels per inch,
individual pixels are hard to distinguish at a typical viewing distance
. That’s also a common resolution for e-readers such as Kindle and Boox.

a93869b8d4fa.source: 所以你当你想要进行长时间阅读时，可以大胆的在微信读书，或者你的阅读器中换上宋体，楷体或其他衬线字体。他们优美的线条会增加你的注意力，降低你阅读的速度，减缓你整体的阅读节奏，独特的字体美学也会体现出字体所带的情绪。
translation: For long reading sessions, try switching
WeRead
or your
e-reader
to
a Song face, a Kai face, or another serif typeface
The shapes of the strokes draw my eye in, slow me down, and change the pace of reading. A typeface can bring a mood of its own.

51f906b21d16.source: 当然也别选太秀技术的书法字体或者抽象的后现代字体，这样效果就过头了。
51f906b21d16.translation: I wouldn’t go too far with an elaborate calligraphic face or an abstract, postmodern one. The type can end up competing with the book.

5ec071771365.source: 我个人喜欢宋体，因为宋体比楷体或其他的没有那么飘逸。它是一种稳定产物，不自带情绪，现代，专注。而楷体花样百出，有的灵动活泼，有的古典玄奥，有的现代扁平。适合特定书记的阅读，我会在下面也推荐一些楷体字体。
5ec071771365.translation: My preference is Song. It feels less buoyant than Kai, more settled, modern and focused. Kai faces have a wider range of personalities: some are lively, others feel classical and enigmatic, and some are spare and modern. They suit particular books. I’ll recommend a couple below.

6e6642b3897b.source: 下载地址：汉仪报宋简-汉仪字库
translation: Download:
Hanyi Bao Song Simplified from Hanyi

5509a4e59abd.source: 这款字体复刻来自老报纸上的宋体，纤细流畅经典，在墨水屏上的效果很好，很像中文老报纸。
translation: This face revives the Song type used in
old newspapers
. Fine, flowing and familiar, it looks especially good on e-ink. It really does feel like reading an old Chinese newspaper.

51dc5c04218a.source: 下载地址：方正博雅宋字体包，方正博雅宋字体打包下载_方正字库官网
translation: Download:
Founder Boya Song from FounderType

152c067f8755.source: 这款字体也是报纸上的字体，目的就是为了优化上面的字体，年代靠后，也是非常经典的字体，相比之下更加扁平，字体没有那么纤细，也就是某种意义上的黑体化。
152c067f8755.translation: Another classic newspaper face, from a later era. It refines the same tradition with a squarer feel and less delicate strokes, borrowing some of the solidity of Hei.

translation: Download:
KingHwa Old Song on Baidu Netdisk

72a9f9d362d8.source: 嘿您怎么找，这味道，哎，就是这味儿，地道。狗啃一般的印刷体带你回到刚建国改用简体字时期的味道。并且并不因此丧失阅读效率，阅读现代作家，古代作家时非常推荐！！（目前修改时已经推出3.0了更加推荐！甚至微信读书自带这款字体了。）
translation: Now this is the real thing.
Utterly authentic
. The
chewed-up edges

take you back to the early years of the People’s Republic, when simplified characters were coming into use. The roughness doesn’t cost you legibility. I especially recommend it for modern and classical Chinese writers. Version 3.0 was out when I revised this piece, and I recommend it even more. It’s now built into WeRead.

71b36ecf666c.source: 具体的介绍：【發佈】京華老宋体(已更新2.0) – 知乎
translation: Read more:
The KingHwa Old Song release announcement on Zhihu

79f18a0c910c.source: 这是Kindle上的默认宋体，不得不说kindle确实是墨水屏的独一档，自带字体的显示效果，调教到了非常好的效果，甚至放在其他阅读器上感觉显示都变得更加锐利了，真的极力推荐！目前最爱用这款！
79f18a0c910c.translation: This is the default Song face on Kindle. Kindle does an exceptional job of tuning its built-in fonts for e-ink. This one even looks sharper to me on other readers. It’s the face I use most right now, and I highly recommend it.

74f444fb9347.source: 下载地址：大家可以在bing上搜一下，这个没有官方下载地址，故不放出了。
74f444fb9347.translation: You can search for it on Bing. I haven’t found an official download, so I’m leaving out the link.

081778f5cb41.source: 第五款：Noto Serif CJK JP & Noto Serif CJK SC & Noto Serif CJK TC
081778f5cb41.translation: Fifth pick: Noto Serif CJK for Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

a96b722fce8e.source: 这款来自国际大厂谷歌的Noto fonts Serif系列这个缝合了日式，中式，台式的CJK因为和普通简体不一样，就算稍微木讷，但是还是有不错的阅读体验的。
a96b722fce8e.translation: Google’s Noto Serif collection brings Japanese, mainland Chinese and Taiwanese forms into one family. It can feel a little stiff beside a face drawn specifically for Simplified Chinese, but it’s still comfortable to read.

7b831cf3862b.source: 除此之外 还有思源宋体，汉仪玄宋35s,方正新书宋，思源屏显臻宋，方正细雅宋。四款推荐。（具有主观喜好排序）
7b831cf3862b.translation: A few more Song faces I like, in roughly my personal order of preference: Source Han Serif, Hanyi Xuan Song 35s, Founder New Book Song, Source Han Screen Zhen Song, and Founder Xiya Song.

c0df2f667acd.source: 楷体就推荐两个最好的：
c0df2f667acd.translation: Two Kai faces stand out for me:

f1da7635fc58.source: Github下载地址：lxgw/LxgwWenKai: An open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks’ Klee One. 一款开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。
translation: Download:
LXGW WenKai on GitHub, an open-source Chinese typeface derived from Fontworks’ Klee One.

155d6173b7ea.source: 这个更是开源作品中名声最造的，免费商用和独具特色的字体样式，一眼就能看出这是霞鹜文楷，但是个人在阅读中感觉略微有些活泼，所以未使用，但只是个人爱好的影响。
155d6173b7ea.translation: It’s one of the best-known open-source Chinese typefaces, free for commercial use and instantly recognisable. I find it a little lively for long reading sessions, so I don’t use it much myself. That’s purely a matter of taste.

badf85b96319.source: 下载地址：仓耳今楷01-W03 – 仓耳屏显字库 – 仓耳字体|屏幕显示字体|艺术字体|免费字体|仓耳字库官网
translation: Download:
Tsanger Jin Kai, design 01 in weight 03, from Tsanger

dd96d8329ddf.source: 该字体也是有字重的，这款在微信读书上使用过一段时间，效果很好，配合微信读书的间距，阅读感受很清新。
dd96d8329ddf.translation: This one comes in multiple weights. I used it for a while in WeRead, where the app’s spacing and the font worked beautifully together. It made the page feel fresh.

bbbbe568ba53.source: 此外大量的楷体字体都是很不错的，Ai楷体等等，不一一列举了。有空再来玩玩。
bbbbe568ba53.translation: There are plenty of other Kai faces worth trying, including Ai Kai. I’ll save the rest for another time.

d8f19b568237.translation: Zhu Zhiwei on fifty years of designing type and his favourite face for reading (Bilibili)

2026-2.sourceTitle: 分享适合长时间阅读的字体以及研究心得
2026-2.sourceSummary: 终于拿到心心念念的文石了，这两天一直在捣鼓这个家伙。
